notes.title: The Modding Tool add-on (DLC) for Rulers of Nations is available!
notes.notes: The Modding Tool add-on lets players create and play contexts and scenarios (mods), as well as share them with other users. More than 100 mods have already been shared and are downloadable with the tool.

notes.title: Other languages coming very soon
notes.notes:
We apologize for having only English version immediately available today, but other languages will be on-line very soon as we are completing the mastering: on Thursday 17th: French and German, and hopefully on Friday 18th, we will have Spanish, Italian, and Russian too.

Note also that the Modding Tool addon DLC should be available next week.

The Eversim dev team.
